w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: Rubble chokes the path.
Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
👁️ Lena freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."

w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Rerun.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "◈ LEVEL UP — FIELD 1. "We've been counting: 18 days worked on the land. Pick one."

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Leaf litter, birdcall, the smell of rot becoming soil. The woods, being the woods.

Movement — a waddling porcupine, quills rattling softly.

You work the patch with practiced hands: 10× Burdock (900 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: A weathered trader waits a while, then moves on down the road. Word travels about that, too.

You camp wild tonight — no hall meal, but the pantry still reaches you through System requisition. Eat from your pack tonight.

w5Mentions.name: The Commercial Break
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 Scouts found the broadcast tower — tile 7,1. THE FINALE does not arrive alone: first, its crew. THE COMMERCIAL BREAK (node 1 of 3). Kill the production staff and the finale airs without a safety net — no one left to call "cut." The march needs 20 allied blades. Sound the call.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A full seat. global standing, every wave faced, the deeds complete. The table rises when you enter. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 4 · Forage 11 · Craft 6 · Talk 19 · Explore 45 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE BELOVED — "Speak for the quiet ones."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Samuel Grilo ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

◈ THE PANTHEON — Samuel Grilo and Ruby Callaghan ascended together, and gods, it turns out, have politics. They argue about you the way the living argue about weather. Mostly, they agree: the village comes first. Mostly.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.
⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.
